description: The script vault: rolling stacks packed rail to rail with bound shooting drafts, continuity binders and tape logs going back further than anyone upstairs admits the station does. A card index sits by the door in a drawer cabinet the size of a coffin, and a lone reading carrel waits under a lamp with a legal pad already on it. It smells of toner, old plastic and the dust that gets into paper. Somewhere in here is the episode they pulled.
name: KSAB Script Vault
